lessons.callout: Steps in order = a sequence of decisions

lines.text: Remember our very first soup? Onions, pot, cook, plate, serve!
In AI words, the cook is the agent. The kitchen is the environment.
Each moment in the kitchen is a state. Each move you pick is an action.
And the right order of actions makes the soup!

card.heading_zh: 第 0 课 · 老师：豆丁 —— 智能体与环境

bullets.text_zh: 做决定的那一方。厨房里，厨师就是智能体。
bullets.def_zh: 做决定的那一方。
bullets.kitchen_zh: 厨房里，厨师就是智能体。
bullets.text_en: The one who makes the decisions. In the kitchen, the chef is the agent.
bullets.def_en: The one who makes the decisions.
bullets.kitchen_en: In the kitchen, the chef is the agent.

bullets.text_zh: 智能体所在的世界。这里就是厨房。
bullets.def_zh: 智能体所在的世界。
bullets.text_en: The world the agent lives in. Here, it is the kitchen.
bullets.def_en: The world the agent lives in.

bullets.text_zh: 此刻环境的样子，比如锅里有几颗洋葱。
bullets.def_zh: 此刻环境的样子，比如锅里有几颗洋葱。
bullets.text_en: What the environment looks like right now, e.g. how many onions are in the pot.
bullets.def_en: What the environment looks like right now, e.g. how many onions are in the pot.

bullets.text_zh: 智能体每一步的选择：走、拿、放、上菜。
bullets.def_zh: 智能体每一步的选择：走、拿、放、上菜。
bullets.text_en: What the agent chooses at each step: walk, pick up, put down, serve.
bullets.def_en: What the agent chooses at each step: walk, pick up, put down, serve.

bullets.text_zh: 关键：做汤需要**按顺序做很多个决定**，这叫序列决策。
bullets.def_zh: 关键：做汤需要**按顺序做很多个决定**，这叫序列决策。
bullets.text_en: Key idea: making soup takes **many decisions in order**. This is called sequential decision-making.
bullets.def_en: Key idea: making soup takes **many decisions in order**. This is called sequential decision-making.

lessons.callout_zh: 按顺序的步骤 = 一连串决策

lessons.callout: You learn what you get rewarded for
terms: stars only for onions → zero soup
small stars for each helpful step → faster

lines.text: Level one was all about rewards! A reward is like a gold star.
When I only got stars for onions, I just piled up onions. Zero soup!
So reward design matters. You learn what you get rewarded for.
Good rewards, like small stars for each helpful step, taught us much faster.

card.heading_zh: 第 1 课 · 老师：Wendy —— 奖励 Reward

bullets.text_zh: 做对一步得到的分数信号，就像金星。
bullets.def_zh: 做对一步得到的分数信号，就像金星。
bullets.text_en: A score signal you get for doing a step right, like a gold star.
bullets.def_en: A score signal you get for doing a step right, like a gold star.

bullets.text_zh: 智能体的目标：让**累计奖励**尽量多。
bullets.def_zh: 智能体的目标：让**累计奖励**尽量多。
bullets.text_en: The agent's goal: get as much **total reward** as possible.
bullets.def_en: The agent's goal: get as much **total reward** as possible.

bullets.text_zh: 奖励给什么，它就学什么。只奖励洋葱，它就只堆洋葱、不做汤（奖励被"钻空子"）。
bullets.def_zh: 奖励给什么，它就学什么。
bullets.kitchen_zh: 只奖励洋葱，它就只堆洋葱、不做汤（奖励被"钻空子"）。
bullets.text_en: Whatever you reward is what it learns. Reward only onions, and it just piles up onions and never makes soup (the reward gets "gamed").
bullets.def_en: Whatever you reward is what it learns.
bullets.kitchen_en: Reward only onions, and it just piles up onions and never makes soup (the reward gets "gamed").

bullets.text_zh: 好办法：给每个有用的小步骤一点小奖励，学得更快（奖励塑形）。
bullets.def_zh: 好办法：给每个有用的小步骤一点小奖励，学得更快（奖励塑形）。
bullets.text_en: A good trick: give a small reward for each useful little step, and it learns faster (reward shaping).
bullets.def_en: A good trick: give a small reward for each useful little step, and it learns faster (reward shaping).

lessons.callout: Try a lot first, then use what works

lines.text: Level two was about exploring. It means trying new things.
With zero curiosity, we kept bumping into walls. No soup at all.
So at first, try a lot. Later, use what works best. That's exploitation.
Trying, and trying again, is how we learned. That's training!

card.heading_zh: 第 2 课 · 老师：Kai —— 探索与利用

bullets.text_zh: 尝试没做过的动作，发现新办法。
bullets.def_zh: 尝试没做过的动作，发现新办法。
bullets.text_en: Trying actions you haven't tried before to find new ways.
bullets.def_en: Trying actions you haven't tried before to find new ways.

bullets.text_zh: 选目前已知最好的动作。
bullets.def_zh: 选目前已知最好的动作。
bullets.text_en: Picking the best action you know so far.
bullets.def_en: Picking the best action you know so far.

bullets.text_zh: 平衡：一开始多探索，后来多利用。完全不探索，就会一直撞墙。
bullets.def_zh: 平衡：一开始多探索，后来多利用。
bullets.kitchen_zh: 完全不探索，就会一直撞墙。
bullets.text_en: Balance: explore a lot at first, then exploit more later. With no exploring at all, it keeps bumping into the wall.
bullets.def_en: Balance: explore a lot at first, then exploit more later.
bullets.kitchen_en: With no exploring at all, it keeps bumping into the wall.

bullets.text_zh: 反复试错、根据奖励调整，一次次变好。
bullets.def_zh: 反复试错、根据奖励调整，一次次变好。
bullets.text_en: Trying again and again, adjusting by the rewards, getting better each time.
bullets.def_en: Trying again and again, adjusting by the rewards, getting better each time.

card.heading_en: Lesson 2 · Teacher: Kai: Exploration and exploitation
card.en_status: draft (EN translated from the Chinese draft, pending Lucy's review)

lessons.callout_zh: 先多尝试，再用有效的办法

terms: value = a guess of how good an action is
solid bubble = sure, dashed = not so sure

lines.text: Level three asked a big question: is the AI sure?
Each action has a value. That's a guess of how good it will be.
Solid bubbles meant sure. Dashed bubbles meant not so sure.
If our confidence is low, don't trust us too much. Think for yourself!

card.heading_zh: 第 3 课 · 老师：豆丁 —— 动作价值与策略

bullets.text_zh: 对"在这个状态做这个动作，以后能得多少奖励"的估计。
bullets.def_zh: 对"在这个状态做这个动作，以后能得多少奖励"的估计。
bullets.text_en: A guess of "if I do this action in this state, how much reward will I get later".
bullets.def_en: A guess of "if I do this action in this state, how much reward will I get later".

bullets.text_zh: 在每个状态选哪个动作的规则，通常选 Q 最高的。
bullets.def_zh: 在每个状态选哪个动作的规则，通常选 Q 最高的。
bullets.text_en: The rule for which action to pick in each state, usually the one with the highest Q.
bullets.def_en: The rule for which action to pick in each state, usually the one with the highest Q.

bullets.text_zh: AI 对自己估计有多确定。实心泡泡=很确定，虚线泡泡=不太确定。
bullets.def_zh: AI 对自己估计有多确定。
bullets.kitchen_zh: 实心泡泡=很确定，虚线泡泡=不太确定。
bullets.text_en: How sure the AI is about its own guess. Solid bubble = very sure, dashed bubble = not so sure.
bullets.def_en: How sure the AI is about its own guess.
bullets.kitchen_en: Solid bubble = very sure, dashed bubble = not so sure.

bullets.text_zh: 关键：AI 不确定时，别全信它，要自己判断。
bullets.def_zh: 关键：AI 不确定时，别全信它，要自己判断。
bullets.text_en: Key idea: when the AI is not sure, don't trust it completely. Think for yourself.
bullets.def_en: Key idea: when the AI is not sure, don't trust it completely. Think for yourself.

card.heading_en: Lesson 3 · Teacher: Dingo: Action values and policy
card.en_status: draft (EN translated from the Chinese draft, pending Lucy's review)

terms: team score = my score + Kai's score
fewer stars for me can mean a better team

lines.text: Level four was teamwork! You played me, and Kai cooked beside you.
Two agents working together is called multi-agent cooperation.
The team score is my score plus Kai's score, added up.
Sometimes you get fewer stars, but the team does better. That's okay.

card.heading_zh: 第 4 课 · 老师：Wendy —— 多智能体合作

bullets.text_zh: 多个智能体在同一个环境里一起行动。
bullets.def_zh: 多个智能体在同一个环境里一起行动。
bullets.text_en: Several agents acting together in the same environment.
bullets.def_en: Several agents acting together in the same environment.

bullets.text_zh: 团队得分 = 每个人得分相加（VDN 的思路）。
bullets.def_zh: 团队得分 = 每个人得分相加（VDN 的思路）。
bullets.text_en: Team score = everyone's scores added together (the VDN idea).
bullets.def_en: Team score = everyone's scores added together (the VDN idea).

bullets.text_zh: 关键：有时个人少得一点，团队整体更好。合作看的是总分。
bullets.def_zh: 关键：有时个人少得一点，团队整体更好。
bullets.text_en: Key idea: sometimes one player gets a little less, but the whole team does better. Teamwork is about the total score.
bullets.def_en: Key idea: sometimes one player gets a little less, but the whole team does better.
bullets.kitchen_en: Teamwork is about the total score.

summary_card.closing_en: In one sentence: an agent takes actions in an environment, learns by trial and error from rewards, learns a policy, and can work together with teammates.
